answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake before trading, released only after a glacier-slow record of verified deliveries. One fake identity then costs locked capital plus weeks of work, and a Sybil farm multiplies that cost across every copy. The stake also creates a clear signal: clusters of new identities funding together, failing checks, or trading only with each other stand out for peer review. If that signal is confirmed, the stake is slashed and the identities lose trading rights, so attacking costs more than the saffron or goods the fakes could divert.
